meta.name: test
meta.description: Write/run tests, check coverage, or TDD discipline. Triggers "test", "write tests", "add tests", "run tests", "coverage", "unit test", "integration test", "TDD", "test-first", "red-green-refactor", "bugs-that-must-not-recur"; post-implementation, pre-merge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动编写并执行测试用例，确保代码质量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速为项目添加测试并提高覆盖率
copy.tagline_en: Automate writing and running tests to ensure code quality
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly add tests and improve coverage

howto.what: Claude 会接管测试任务，包括编写/运行测试、检查代码覆盖率，并强制遵循 TDD 流程（红-绿-重构）。它会生成测试文件、执行测试并总结覆盖情况与缺口。
howto.when: 当你提出“写测试”、“运行测试”、“覆盖率”、“TDD”等关键词，或在实现功能后、合并代码前要求测试时触发。

say.text: 为这个登录组件写单元测试
say.note: Claude 会创建测试文件并执行。

say.text: 运行所有测试并报告覆盖率
say.note: Claude 会执行测试并汇总覆盖情况。

say.text: 用 TDD 实现用户注册功能
say.note: Claude 会按照红-绿-重构循环逐步开发。

howto.what_en: Claude takes over testing tasks: writing/running tests, checking coverage, and enforcing TDD discipline (red-green-refactor). It generates test files, executes the suite, and reports coverage and gaps.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "test", "write tests", "coverage", "TDD", or request testing after implementation or before merging.

say_en.text: Write unit tests for this login component
say_en.note: Claude creates test files and runs them.

say_en.text: Run all tests and report coverage
say_en.note: Claude executes the suite and summarizes coverage.
